opportunities.name: TheDAO Security Fund
opportunities.summary: Apply for grants from TheDAO Security Fund, a January 2026 initiative that reactivated 75,000+ ETH in dormant 2016 DAO recovery assets to fund Ethereum security work. Yield (~$8M/year) is distributed via quadratic funding, retroPGF, and ranked-choice voting to security researchers, tooling developers, and rapid-response teams. Application mechanics are still being finalized; specific eligibility criteria listed as TBD on the campaign page.
opportunities.fit_reason: Brand-new Jan 2026 Ethereum security endowment; application process forming

opportunities.name: ZKsync Community Activation Pilot – RFP Pool
opportunities.amount: 13.6M ZK tokens (~$680K USD) in competitive RFP pool
opportunities.summary: Apply to ZKsync's 12-month Community Activation Pilot (Aug 2025–Aug 2026) by responding to continuously published RFPs on the ZK Nation Governance Forum. Four tracks: Product Marketing & Activation, Adoption Enablement, Data & Transparency, Community Tooling. Applicants must specify deliverables, budget, and KPIs, then complete KYC/KYB; payment is in ZK tokens milestone-based or phased.
opportunities.fit_reason: New 2025-2026 pilot with rolling RFPs; active window includes June 2026

opportunities.name: Arbitrum Audit Subsidy Program
opportunities.summary: Apply for subsidized smart contract audits from Arbitrum's $10M program, launched Aug 1 2025 and running through Aug 2026. Eligible projects are early-stage, not yet launched or recently launched on Arbitrum One or launching an Orbit chain, with new or significantly modified codebases. Submissions collect GitHub repos, audit scope, and preferred auditor; the Audit Committee reviews on a rolling basis.
opportunities.fit_reason: Largest crypto audit subsidy pool; confirmed accepting applications through Aug 2026

opportunities.name: Taiko Grant Program (2025 Grant Fund)
opportunities.summary: Apply to Taiko's $25M grant fund across six tracks — DeFi, AI, RWA, SocialFi, Gaming, and Other — by submitting an application through taiko.xyz/grant-program. The Grants Council reviews rolling submissions and contacts applicants directly; all smart contracts and frontend code must be open-sourced from inception. KYC/KYB required for all grantees.
opportunities.fit_reason: $25M rolling pool actively accepting submissions across broad web3 tracks

opportunities.name: Sui DeFi Moonshots Program
opportunities.amount: up to $500K in liquidity incentives per project
opportunities.summary: Apply to Sui Foundation's DeFi Moonshots Program, targeting top-tier DeFi protocol teams building on Sui, offering up to $500K in liquidity incentives plus direct collaboration with Sui's DeFi engineering specialists. No equity required. Apply via the Sui Foundation's programs page.
opportunities.fit_reason: Up to $500K liquidity incentives for DeFi protocols; confirmed open on canonical page

opportunities.name: Avalanche Foundation Research Grants
opportunities.summary: Apply for up to $50K to conduct original research on Avalanche network economics, including cryptoasset pricing/valuation models, validator economics, token emission schedules, and novel value accrual mechanisms. Open to academic researchers and independent scholars; proposals capped at 10 pages. Disbursement across three milestones over 12 months: 30%/30%/40%. Submit at build.avax.network/grants/avalanche-research-proposals.
opportunities.fit_reason: Rolling research grants up to $50K; confirmed active with no closing date on canonical page

opportunities.name: Alchemy + Arbitrum Orbit Grant
opportunities.amount: up to $500K per team in infrastructure credits (~$1M remaining of $10M pool)
opportunities.summary: Apply for up to $500K in Alchemy infrastructure credits for teams building new Orbit chains or migrating existing chains to Arbitrum Orbit. Program is first-come-first-served with only ~$1M remaining from the original $10M pool — near-depleted but still accepting applications via alchemy.com/arbitrum-grant-contact. Includes co-marketing with both Arbitrum and Alchemy.
opportunities.fit_reason: Still open but nearly depleted ($1M of $10M remaining); Orbit chain infrastructure focus
